text:
alex: quick sync - proposal for a tiny header-driven routing hint so REST callers can opt-in to explicit route ids and quota keys without heavy client libs. goal: make routing predictable and give proto-first teams canonical mappings.
maria: i like the idea but big red flag on spoofing. how do we avoid public clients claiming other tenants' quota or routes?
alex: plan is signed hints only. two verification modes: (1) introspect token -> server returns allowed route ids/quotas; (2) client presents a short HMAC-signed header produced by console or an SDK. headers: X-RW-Route, X-RW-Quota, X-RW-Canary (opt), X-RW-Trace (opt), X-RW-Debug (opt). example: 
POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
Host: inference.internal
Authorization: Bearer <token>
X-RW-Route: model.generate
X-RW-Quota: org:acme_sales
X-RW-Sig: v1.hmac:abc123
{ "prompt": "Summarize docs" }
jordan: keep a route registry in control plane mapping proto_service.method <-> route id. edge accepts explicit route id or falls back to path+method lookup. also propose a control-plane lint that flags route ids without proto mapping.
sam: quota resolution: precedence = signed header quota > tenant from token > route default. support aggregation labels (org/team/env) and ensure billing uses resolved tenant mapping. write tests for quota collisions when a header claims an org but token belongs to a project.
lucy: telemetry: emit counters `rw.router.hint.accepted`, `rw.router.hint.rejected`, `rw.router.hint.sig_fail`, and gauge `rw.router.hint_fallback_rate`. trace propagation: honor incoming trace id or attach new one. debug flow: Console can mint a short-lived `X-RW-Debug` token (signed) so support teams can escalate sampling without exposing keys.
maria: signed header generation needs UX in console + SDK helper to avoid friction. also rate-limit debug token minting.
alex: perf concern: signature verification cost per-request. mitigate with per-tenant key cache and bloom filter fast-path for known-valid tokens. measure in staging.
jordan: compatibility mode: allow a JSON envelope `_route` field for legacy clients but treat it as low-trust (cannot escalate quotas or canaries). envelope example: `{ "_route": "model.generate", "payload": { ... } }`. mark envelope requests in telemetry.
sam: console UX suggestions: route detail page shows calls/min, p50/p95, quota usage (daily, monthly), active canaries, and a small CSV export button for quota binds. add a quick "mint debug token" CTA.
ops-bot: deploy-proxy v3 canary started on staging (canary-3) with route-hint feature flag ON. initial logs show `rw.router.hint.accepted=47`.
lucy: i'll add dashboard panels and a small alert when `hint.sig_fail` spikes > threshold. also track `hint_fallback_rate` to see adoption.
alex: action items: i'll draft a short RFC (header spec, security model, fallback rules). sam: quota resolution pseudocode + tests. lucy: telemetry + dashboards. jordan: control-plane lint proposal. maria: console UI for token minting. RFC by EOW, perf sweep in staging tomorrow. :thumbsup:
